gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (modified accrual) Total revenues 4,059,564 = General 2,010,179 + Street 849,320 + Sales Tax 844,123 + Other Governmental 355,942. detail[]: General Fund combining schedule p21 = 2,010,179 and nonmajor combining statement p19 = 355,942 (both tie to their statement columns); Street Fund and Sales Tax Fund come from the BUDGETARY COMPARISON SCHEDULE - CASH BASIS pages: Street p15 total resources 833,386 (statement 849,320: short 15,934; property taxes 43,622 vs 43,661, sales taxes 128,339 vs 125,950, highway allocation 661,056 vs intergovernmental 679,340) and Sales Tax p16 sales taxes 849,836 (statement 844,123: above by 5,713). 15,934 - 5,713 = 10,221 = gap. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis (cash vs modified accrual); no detail fix.

p7 Total expenditures 4,774,894 = General 3,746,114 + Street 463,310 + Sales Tax 188,218 + Other Governmental 377,252. detail[]: General Fund combining schedule p21 = 3,746,114 and nonmajor p19 = 355,280 + 19,062 + 300 + 2,610 = 377,252 (tie). Cash-basis budget schedules: Street p15 total charges to appropriations 435,197 vs statement 463,310 (Public Works 421,796 + capital outlay 41,514): short 28,113; Sales Tax p16 total outflows 348,218 (Other expenses 160,000 + principal 140,000 + interest 48,218) vs statement 188,218 (principal 140,000 + interest 48,218; the 160,000 cash outflow is not a GAAP expenditure): above by 160,000. 28,113 - 160,000 = -131,887 = gap. Printed totals differ by basis; no detail fix.

p10 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints five major fund columns (Electric, Gas, Water, Sewer, Ethanol) with no schedule of their own; detail[] holds only the nonmajor combining statement p20 (Solid Waste 251,873 + Meter Deposit 13,347 + 3,861 = 269,081). Missing revenues by column (p10): Electric 3,819,558 + 40,662 + 44,065 + 39,749 = 3,944,034; Gas 1,383,907 + 451 + 81,075 + 1,285 = 1,466,718; Water 465,821; Sewer 400,956 + 22,269 + 118,728 + 22,659 = 564,612; Ethanol 600,955; sum 7,042,140 = gap exactly. 269,081 + 7,042,140 = 7,311,221 = statement total. Transfers of these columns (p10: Electric in 42,000 / out (560,000), Gas out (232,000), Water in 193,742 / out (75,000), Sewer in 283,279 / out (148,000), Ethanol out (838,543)) are not added because this report has no business-type transfers gap row.
